    value = abs(n)
    count = 0
    while value:
        count += value & 1
        value >>= 1
    return count

import math
def value_at_percentile(values, p):
    ordered = sorted(values)
    n = len(ordered)
    index = math.ceil(p / 100 * n) - 1
    index = max(0, min(n - 1, index))
    return ordered[index]
